author: Nintendo of America
description:
Play Absolum - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition now: https://ninten.do/6001adCnT

Play as the outcast heroes of Talamh, explore dangerous lands, battle brutal bosses, unlock powerful upgrades, and uncover the mystery of Azra's absolute magical power! 

Absolum - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition runs at 60 fps for smoother gameplay, has improved resolution, and lets you play with Gameshare locally. Nintendo Switch players will be able to upgrade to the Switch 2 version for free while keeping their earned progression and saved games! 

Will you defy the Sun King and change the fate of this world? 

#Absolum
